name: Sustainable productized service: buyer fit and operating constraints
goal: Harden a productized service by clarifying why fixed packages convert (skip scoping foreplay for known outcomes), when giant custom shops avoid them, and which operating constraints (capacity, revisions, stack, rush fees) keep the offer sane and profitable.

source.title: how to actually build a sustainable productized service ($20k+)

constraints: Operational freelancing/product procedure only — no get-rich-quick claims.
Ground every step in YouTube-provided captions; adapt UI labels if the product renamed menus.

steps.action: Name the sales benefit: productizing skips mutual scoping foreplay when the client wants a known outcome fast (startup-like buyers).
Acknowledge why large heterogeneous agencies often avoid pure SKUs; choose the repeatable-SKU lane deliberately.
Add constraints: capacity caps, revision limits, allowed tech stack, rush fees — small tweaks that preserve happiness on both sides.
Align internal fulfillment with client expectation so the package is sustainable, not only marketable.
